title: Sequencing: Red Rose Speedway by Wings | 1973
content:
Room Four, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Richard Lush

Wings settled on the final sequencing for the Red Rose Speedway album on 19 February 1973.

This was the second of two final sequencing sessions, with the first taking place three days earlier. They were necessary after EMI rejected the band’s plans to release a double album, insisting that only a single disc would be commercially viable.

With the final running order in place, Red Rose Speedway was compiled and sent for mastering, ahead of its April 1973 release.
